entries.title: Pictures, files and notes go with a card's buttons
entries.body: A picture, a file or a note you queued in a card's field no longer has to go as a reply first. Every button stays ready, a line says what goes with it, and one press sends your choice with your words, pictures, files and notes together. A past card names what went with its choice.

picture.alt: A card with a picture and a note waiting in its field, its buttons lit and a line reading 1 picture and 1 note go with your choice
